Uttar Pradesh CM Yogi Adityanath Highlights Development and Investment

Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath has been actively promoting development and investment in the state. Recent reports highlight his involvement in launching various development projects, attracting investment commitments, and emphasizing progress in areas like housing and sanitation. He also addressed issues related to land allocation and public safety.
